rca of the issue: Original user report: 'I'm only getting .txt files for bulk images.' Two compounding bugs: (1) _safe_filename() in artifacts.py used to silently coerce ANY non-allowed extension (including binary like .png/.mp4/.pdf) to .txt, persisting base64 garbage as text-with-wrong-name. Now returns ('','') for any BINARY_EXTS member, the caller drops the block, and a user-visible '⚠️ I tried to emit binary file(s)…' notice is appended. (2) The chat flow only generated 1 image even when user asked for 5; agent's only fallback was to emit ARTIFACT blocks with .png names which the broken sanitizer turned into .txt. Now detect_image_count() parses 'create 5 hero images' → 5 (capped at 8), and _generate_bulk_images() renders N distinct images each as its own agent message with variant hints. Verified end-to-end via direct unit tests + mocked nano-banana integration tests.
